reviews.text:
My dog Buddy swallowed a stone. I didn’t know. He started vomiting, not eating or drinking. I took him next morning to Vahid. He examined him and diagnosed a foreign body in his intestines. Buddy needed immediate surgery and was transferred to the vet hospital. There he needed IV fluids, nasogastric feeding and aspiration . He stayed there for 4 days.
Every night at 6pm his own vet Vahid phoned to ask how Buddy was. On discharge from the hospital, Vahid checked Buddy was coming for a review. When I took Buddy along on the Saturday morning, Vahid was so delighted to see that Buddy was on the mend. He said ‘oh Buddy my boy, thank god you’re getting better’
OMG I’ve been absolutely amazed with the care and love shown to my dog by Vahid. I can’t thank him enough. I see him as our family vet he knows both my dogs and cares for them exceptionally. Thanks Vahid💕💕

They are amazing.
Always explain everything
Specially Lauren she is very kind and helpful.

Honestly cannot praise the team here enough! Had interactions with all of the team over the years and never had a bad experience. The team always have the animals best interest at heart. My boy is treated like a VIP on every visit. Special shout out to the girls at the front who are just delightful - thank you x
Solved the problem with our Puppy! Great service. Friendly staff.
Great service as always

Called the vets office to enquire about teeth burring for my wee rabbit, she was really sickly at this point and the girl on the phone was absolutely amazing. She spoke me through all the costs and was so gentle and understanding, I was an absolute mess!

Prices and what was to be done were explained clearly and appointments were booked quickly, my wee bun ended up having two teeth removed.

From the initial phone call to post op vets for pets were absolutely excellent, the girls on the desk were fantastic and just so kind.

I wouldn’t consider using anyone else now!

Thank you for everything you’ve done for us!
Staff are always really kind and helpful ♡ We had our cat in again this week and I am always reminded of how great they are!
Fantastic vets friendly helpful staff

My niece took her cat here to have his ears checked and after a 6 minute clean of his ears and some advice she was charged £183.00 it is absolutely disgusting. His ears are still bothering him and its heartbreaking to watch him struggle with this. I'm glad I'm having the chance to go public with this as it is daylight robbery
Great vet always very helpful and sympathetic

Avoid this vet at all costs! My elderly mum took her dog and paid £110 for health check we were told this would be around 30 mins and then 55 for flea treatment Vahid Ardani was horribly rude he did not check the dog just looked at his teeth when my mum asked about bites he sed u have to point this out to me and sed to test would cost £300 my mum was less than 5 mins in the office he was rude and not interested in the dog atall. We now have to pay to take the dog to another vet for a proper check up as he told us nothing he always advised he was the manager of the practice ajd told my mum not to come back. Disgusting way to treat a customer and there pet I will never return and wont let this go. Strangely enough there is no customer service number to contact only an email

Very poor customer service. I always get incorrect information. I once called to make an appointment for Lola, but I don't know why "someone" is also making an appointment for Pirate. Before the appointment, I received a text message about Lola and Pirate's appointment, which I hadn't even asked about. I brought my two dogs with me to the appointment and asked the receptionist to check Pirate's information because he was already vaccinated, and she replied, "Please sit down, the vet will check it." I was ignored. I don't know what the problem is with providing this information? Too difficult? Of course, the vet never checked and double-vaccinated Pirate, and then the vet told me the receptionist failed. Today I was told it was the vet's fault, LOL, it's a circus. I am so regred I did not write official complaint , "sorry" is not enough for me or that pathetic " I am so sorry hear that". You put my dog on reask receptionist to lazy to providing information and vet not checking before vaxined!!
I pay for a care plan, and I can't get what I pay for. Of course, I received different information about this from the vet and the receptionist. And of course, no one can accept blame for someone who is at fault, just like the children. The service at Bersden is much better. I don't recommend this place. It's strange when you can't even find information about your dog! I took my puppies in for a checkup a year ago, and the vet came up with some strange illnesses a month later The puppies had checkups elsewhere, and none of these strange illnesses were confirmed. The dogs are healthy. They were told they had heart defects, something with their teeth, and that one of the puppies needed kneecap surgery because his hind legs wouldn't bend. Shocking!
Done a great job stitching my cats paw after he tore his skin almost to the bone everything was explained before & after op

An absoloute great place to get ur pet treats, foods and toys and much much more.
The staff are super friendly and the vets in the back of the store are just incredible. The way they look after every pet is just sooo reassuring. Would never go anywhere else. This team is hands down 11/10

🐾 **Vets4Pets Drumchapel – A First-Class Experience!**

We took our wee cocker spaniel into Vets4Pets in Drumchapel today Saturday 2nd August after a nasty bee sting, and from start to finish, the care was absolutely outstanding.

✨ **From the moment we arrived without an appointment**, Amanda on the front desk greeted us with warmth, professionalism, and such a lovely manner—it instantly put us at ease. She’s a real asset to the team and makes the whole experience smooth and stress-free.

🐶 Gracie was looked after with genuine compassion and expertise. Ian the vet handled everything efficiently and made sure our little one was comfortable and safe throughout the visit. It’s clear they care deeply about the animals they treat and the people they serve.

👏 I can’t recommend Vets4Pets Drumchapel enough. First-class service, wonderful staff, and a place where your pets are treated like family.

Thank you again to Amanda and the whole team—you were amazing!

Love from Wee Gracie Allan 💕

Honestly I cannot praise this practice enough. I have a very anxious romanian rescue dog and both Alison and Ian have gone out their way to accommodate my dog. Alison at reception is a delight and Ian is one of the best vets I have gone to.

Decided to leave vets 4 pets as the vet has been terrible multiple times has not handled my dog kindly he was rough with him on multiple occasions when there was no need for it and talked down at me as if I didn't know how to care for my own dog would not recommend going to this vet as the vets attitude is terrible and does not know how to handle animals kindly.

We never received any proper help while with our sick kitten. The kitten has been sick for several weeks, and without any examination, we only got a wormer (which we had done before a couple of times) plus vaccination, and then another wormer. The kitten was only getting weaker. We then changed the vet and got her poo tested, Received appropriate medication, and our kitten got over within a week!! since changing the vet

I don’t think I have the words to describe the team at Vets for Pets Drumchapel, and if I do - they still won’t be enough.

I’ve been quite a regular to the practice over the past three years as my Cat Rupert has a rare condition - and since day one the team have gone above and beyond.

I’ve never seen anyone show as much passion and love for animals (particularly my Rupert 😂)  and their work as the vet Vahid. Since day one he was determined to find out what was wrong with my cat Rupert, seeking second opinions and doing research leaving no stone unturned to get to the bottom of his issues. His evident passion and care for the animals and his work have always put me at ease, and there’s nobody else I’d take my pets to - put it this way, if he took humans I’d be asking him to be my doctor 😂

And the rest of the practice team - where do I start? Since day one they’ve been there to reassure me - mop up tears and brighten up my mood when I’ve been worried and bring laughter to every visit.   Lauren, Allison, Ryla and Katie are absolute angels, and I look forward to seeing their smiling faces every time I visit - it’s like catching up with friends every time.

I could go on for ever - but in summary It doesn’t feel like “taking Rupert to the Vets” it’s more like bringing him to see his other family at this point, and the comfort that brings me will forever be priceless.

Thank you all for everything you do ❤️

All the vets in this company are students. And they don't know anything about animals. I took my cat to the vet for a checkup and she didn't dare to touch it properly. In the end, they charged me 50 pounds and the vet didn't understand the real problem with my cat. My cat is sick now. I really have a responsibility to my cat. And it's really bad that all the vets are students and you don't replace these doctors with professional doctors. If your pet's life is important to you, don't sign up for this company's health plan. There are very irresponsible people who will cause the death of your pet These student vets

I have had the pleasure of being seen by Camille twice now for my Labrador Cody. Cody has always been an extremely nervous dog, but Camilles presence calms him right down and he was even happy to lay down and relax (this never happens!) Thank you Camille for being amazingly patient and kind with us both.
Friendly staff
I'm very happy because is very nice vets is fast
My granddaughter loves this shop
Very excellent and thoughtful service! The staff are very warm-hearted and responsive!
